title: Connecting GitHub is optional
when: GitHub step, access refusal or later integration request
need: Skip the integration when it is not wanted or available. Authorization and repository access need their own checks; skipped GitHub is not a failed readiness check. Recommend All repositories for the product App so future repositories need no settings visit; selected installations show their direct settings link in setup and status. Explain that all repositories grants access across the account and that user authorization does not change installation scope.
gap: Accepted correction: skipped GitHub makes the token check N/A. Audit exactly which later operations require GitHub and provide alternatives only where supported.
review: Repository-scope teaching observed in source and regression tests; GitHub documents all repositories selected when repository IDs are omitted. Optional-connection recipe still needs live proof.
